cms_tribal_hospital_crosswalk.observation: CMS's IHS-CMS All Tribal Facilities Listing identifies KANAKANAK HOSPITAL as a Hospital with CCN 021309 in Dillingham, Alaska. The listing states that CMS cross-referenced an IHS facility list with QCOR; created 2020-01-26.

ihs_current_tribal_cah_listing.observation: IHS's current Critical Access Hospitals fact sheet lists Kanakanak Hospital, Alaska, as Tribal.

ihs_current_operator_evidence.observation: IHS's July 2025 report identifies Kanakanak Hospital as a critical access facility in Dillingham managed by Bristol Bay Area Health Corporation, which it identifies as a tribal organization.

ihs_isdeaa_program_evidence.observation: IHS's Bristol Bay Service Area Profile identifies Kanakanak Hospital at 6000 Kanakanak Road, PO Box 130, Dillingham AK 99576 and states BBAHC operates it and other facilities under P.L. 93-638, Title V; it describes BBAHC as the first tribal organization to take over operation of an IHS hospital under the Indian Self Determination Act.

legal_basis.regulation_observation: CMS deems hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, as defined by section 4(12) of the Indian Health Care Improvement Act, to be in compliance with Part 180.
legal_basis.statute_observation: Indian Health Program includes a tribal health program; a tribal health program is a tribe or tribal organization operating a health facility funded in whole or part by IHS through an ISDEAA contract or compact.

prior_price_transparency_observations.observation: The current BBAHC transparency page links the Kanakanak PARA pricing resource. Previously observed route-level 404 responses for that resource and https://bbahc.org/cms-hpt.txt remain transport/publication observations only; they do not establish current MRF availability or absence.

interpretation: CMS's crosswalk explicitly binds hospital identity, CCN 021309, Dillingham and Alaska. IHS currently identifies Kanakanak as a tribal critical access hospital and its 2025 report identifies BBAHC, a tribal organization, as its manager. IHS's service-area profile connects the exact hospital and address to BBAHC operation under P.L. 93-638, Title V / the Indian Self Determination Act. Read with 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2) and 25 USC 1603(12),(25), this supports the Indian Health Program scope category. This is a scope classification only; it does not assert pointer linkage, current MRF availability, absence, or file quality.
next_action: Retain the supported scope classification and prior route-level 404 observations as provenance. Revisit if exact CCN identity, operator, contract/compact, or program status changes. Do not infer whether a current MRF is or is not posted.
